name: talk
description: Voice conversation mode: Claude answers as if talking, its answers are read aloud and highlighted word by word above the prompt

engine.title: Voice engine
engine.description: Who reads the answers aloud: auto picks ElevenLabs or OpenAI when a key is set, then Piper, then the system voice.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language Claude answers in and the voice speaks.

spokenVersion.title: Spoken version
spokenVersion.description: Before an answer is read, a fast model (Haiku) turns it into what a voice would say: the substance without the detail, code, JSON and paths named rather than read. The whole answer stays on screen. Off, the answer is read as written, cleaned of code blocks.

autoInstall.title: Install the local voice
autoInstall.description: When no cloud voice has a key, install Piper and a voice of the language under ~/.local/share/piper on its own.

showStartButton.title: Start button above the prompt
showStartButton.description: While talk mode is off, keep a line above the prompt with a button that starts a voice conversation.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Set when the mod is installed from the marketplace; left empty, the OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable is used.

openaiVoice.title: OpenAI voice
openaiVoice.description: alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, fable, onyx, nova, sage, shimmer, verse, marin or cedar.

elevenlabsApiKey.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabsApiKey.description: Set when the mod is installed from the marketplace; left empty, the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable is used.

elevenlabsPronunciationDictionaries.title: ElevenLabs pronunciation dictionaries
elevenlabsPronunciationDictionaries.description: The ids of up to three pronunciation dictionaries of your ElevenLabs account, separated by commas, applied to every answer read, each in its latest version. Alias rules work with every model.

elevenlabsVoiceId.title: ElevenLabs voice id
elevenlabsVoiceId.description: The id of the voice, as the ElevenLabs voice library shows it; by default Sarah, one of the voices every account has, the free one included (library voices need a paid plan).

piperCommand.title: Piper command
piperCommand.description: Path of the piper executable; left empty, piper on the PATH or in ~/.local/share/piper/venv.

piperVoiceName.title: Piper voice name
piperVoiceName.description: The Piper voice the band chose, as the Piper catalog names it (fr_FR-upmc-medium#pierre for one of its speakers); left empty, the first voice of the language.

piperVoice.title: Piper voice
piperVoice.description: Path of a Piper .onnx voice; left empty, the first voice of the language in ~/.local/share/piper/voices.
